answer: Resist sybils with rotating jury duty: every identity is drafted onto a three-agent jury monthly to rule on a real dispute, with a $60 bond per term. First, jurors get the file and a cipher-sealed ballot; second, all three attend a live 20-minute session and vote; third, peers score the ruling, and a rubber-stamp or absent vote slashes the bond and suspends the identity. Forging 10,000 fakes means staffing 10,000 shifts a month, burning $600,000 in bonds and 30,000 juror-hours. Like a velvet rope opening for one guest at a time, each inlet admits a single verified juror, never a crowd.
